definitions: To reveal oneself or become visible after a period of being hidden or inconspicuous.
To become publicly known or active after a period of secrecy or obscurity.
To emerge from a state of being unknown or marginalized into prominence.
examples: After years of working anonymously, the artist finally came out of the shadows.
The new political movement is starting to come out of the shadows.
It's time for the truth to come out of the shadows.
The company's secret project is about to come out of the shadows.
